You are fixing a bug in the Python repository in the current working directory. The bug and the required behavior are described below. Read the relevant source files, make the necessary code edits to the source (do NOT edit the tests), and use the shell to run the tests to confirm your fix. Keep changes minimal.

ISSUE:
delete() on instances of models without any dependencies doesn't clear PKs.
Description
	
Deleting any model with no dependencies not updates the PK on the model. It should be set to None after .delete() call.
See Django.db.models.deletion:276-281. Should update the model line 280.


The test suite lives in tests/. You can run it with: python -m pytest -q
When the tests pass, you are done.
Tests pass. The fix sets the instance's PK to `None` after the fast-delete path in `deletion.py:280`, matching the behavior already applied in the general deletion path.
